config.name: Availability (2xx+3xx share, %)
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT round(100 * countIf(StatusCode != 'Error') / greatest(count(), 1), 2) AS availability_pct FROM default.otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'edgy'

config.name: 5xx responses in range
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT count() AS server_errors FROM default.otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'edgy' AND StatusCode = 'Error'

config.name: Error spans by route
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS ts, SpanName AS route, count() AS errors FROM default.otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'edgy' AND StatusCode = 'Error' GROUP BY ts, route ORDER BY ts

config.name: Spans over 1s
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS ts, count() AS slow_spans FROM default.otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'edgy' AND Duration > 1e9 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

config.name: Logs needing attention
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT Timestamp, ServiceName, SeverityText, Body, TraceId FROM default.otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = 'edgy' AND SeverityText NOT IN ('info', 'INFO', 'debug', 'DEBUG', 'trace', 'TRACE') ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

config.name: Dropped telemetry (refused minus accepted)
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, sumIf(Value, MetricName LIKE '%refused%') AS refused, sumIf(Value, MetricName LIKE '%accepted%') AS accepted FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName LIKE 'otelcol_receiver_%' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

config.name: Collector CPU seconds (rate)
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, round(max(Value), 2) AS cpu_seconds FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'otelcol_process_cpu_seconds' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts
